```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r step2}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```


## Task 1
```{r task1}
#Listings per host id
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(host_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(host_listing_count = dplyr::n())
host_counts

#Join (chatISA helped me with the second statement)
listings_with_host_count = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

#A1
hosts_10plus <- host_counts |>
  dplyr::select(host_listing_count) |>
  dplyr::filter(host_listing_count >= 10) |>
  dplyr::arrange(host_listing_count)
nrow(hosts_10plus)

#A2
hosts_10plus_chicago <- listings_with_host_count |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarise(pct_10plus_hosts = mean(host_listing_count >= 10) * 100) #because it's a percentage
hosts_10plus_chicago
```

## Task 2
```{r task2}
family_of_four <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt", accommodates >= 4, number_of_reviews >= 10, review_scores_rating >= 4.8) |>
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates)

#A3
A3 <- family_of_four |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarise(median_price_per_person = median(price_per_person), n = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::filter(n >= 20, city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_price_per_person)
A3
```

## Task 3
```{r task3}
city_room_type_summary <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
                  \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

#A4
A4 <- city_room_type_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities", room_type == "Entire home/apt")
A4
```

## Task 4
```{r task4}
revenue_ranked <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rank = 1:dplyr::n(), top10 = rank <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  )

#A5
A5 <- revenue_ranked |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    pct_revenue_top10 = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top10], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )
A5
```

## Task 5
```{r task5}
entire_homes <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt")

october_availability <- availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

entire_homes_oct <- entire_homes |>
  dplyr::inner_join(october_availability, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month)

# Top row after sorting = the city with the LOWEST share of mostly-taken entire homes
# city column of top row = A6
# share_mostly_taken of top row = A7
entire_homes_oct |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarise(share_mostly_taken = mean(mostly_taken) * 100) |>
  dplyr::arrange(share_mostly_taken)
```

## Task 6
```{r task6}
reviews_with_city <- reviews |>
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07", month <= "2026-06") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(listings, by = "id")

reviews_by_city_month <- reviews_with_city |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(total_reviews = sum(reviews))

# A8: top row after sorting largest first
reviews_by_city_month |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))

# A9: ratio of busiest month's total reviews to quietest month's total reviews
reviews_by_city_month |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::summarise(busiest = max(total_reviews), quietest = min(total_reviews), ratio_busiest_to_quietest = busiest / quietest)
```

## Task 7
```{r task7}
entire_homes_known_superhost <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt", host_is_superhost == "t" | host_is_superhost == "f")

city_superhost_summary <- entire_homes_known_superhost |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarise(median_price = median(price), median_rating = median(review_scores_rating))

superhosts <- city_superhost_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(host_is_superhost == "t") |>
  dplyr::rename(median_price_superhost = median_price, median_rating_superhost = median_rating) |>
  dplyr::select(city, median_price_superhost, median_rating_superhost)

other_hosts <- city_superhost_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(host_is_superhost == "f") |>
  dplyr::rename(median_price_other = median_price, median_rating_other = median_rating) |>
  dplyr::select(city, median_price_other, median_rating_other)

premiums <- superhosts |>
  dplyr::inner_join(other_hosts, by = "city") |>
  dplyr::mutate(premium = median_price_superhost - median_price_other)

premiums |>
  dplyr::select(city, premium)
```

## Task 8
```{r task8}
listings_no_availability <- listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id")

# A10: listings with no rows in availability at all
nrow(listings_no_availability)

# Which city loses the most
listings_no_availability |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarise(count = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(count))
```
